podcast.title: Caribbean Influence
podcast.body: Records from the New Orleans area, including some by Shirley and Lee like "Feel So Good," often showed a noticeable Caribbean influence in their style. "records like Feel So Good, showing some of the Caribbean influence that many records from the area had."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Influence of Fats Domino
podcast.body: The entire genre of New Orleans music owes a profound debt to Fats Domino for his foundational contributions and unique sound, which shaped its development and influence. "The whole of New Orleans music owes a debt to him."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Popularity in Jamaican Sound Systems
podcast.body: New Orleans R&B was immensely popular among Jamaican sound system listeners. Artists like Shirley and Lee, Fats Domino, Lloyd Price, and Professor Longhair, whose music was in this style, were heavily featured. "Like much new Orleans R&B, Shirley and Lee were hugely popular among the sound system listeners."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
